source_en: Users with administrator permission must sign in from one of these networks and use existing browser sessions from an allowed network. Regular users can continue to sign in remotely. API-key integrations are unchanged.

proposal: Giới hạn đăng nhập quản trị viên trong các mạng đáng tin cậy
source_en: Restrict Administrator Sign-In to Trusted Networks

proposal: Nhập ít nhất một mạng được phép cho quản trị viên.
source_en: Enter at least one allowed administrator network.

proposal: Yêu cầu đăng nhập bằng Jellyfin Quick Connect
source_en: Require Jellyfin Quick Connect Sign-In

proposal: Cho phép đăng nhập bằng Jellyfin Quick Connect và chặn đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu Jellyfin hoặc qua plugin.
source_en: Allow Jellyfin Quick Connect sign-in and block Jellyfin password and plugin sign-in.

proposal: Jaringan yang Diizinkan untuk Administrator
source_en: Allowed Administrator Networks

proposal: Masukkan hingga 100 alamat IPv4 atau IPv6 atau subnet CIDR, satu per baris (total 4096 karakter), misalnya 192.168.0.0/16 atau 100.64.0.0/10. Klien yang menyimpan daftar yang diubah harus tetap diizinkan.
source_en: Enter up to 100 IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or CIDR subnets, one per line (4096 characters total), such as 192.168.0.0/16 or 100.64.0.0/10. The client saving a changed list must remain allowed.

proposal: Jika SeerrNG berada di belakang reverse proxy, aktifkan opsi untuk memercayai reverse proxy dan pastikan proxy menimpa X-Forwarded-For. Batasi akses langsung ke SeerrNG agar klien tidak dapat memalsukan alamat yang digunakan untuk pemeriksaan ini.
source_en: When SeerrNG is behind a reverse proxy, enable Trust Reverse Proxy and ensure the proxy overwrites X-Forwarded-For. Restrict direct access to SeerrNG so clients cannot forge the address used for this check.

proposal: Pengguna dengan izin administrator harus masuk dari salah satu jaringan ini dan menggunakan sesi browser yang sudah ada dari jaringan yang diizinkan. Pengguna biasa tetap dapat masuk dari jarak jauh. Integrasi kunci API tidak berubah.
source_en: Users with administrator permission must sign in from one of these networks and use existing browser sessions from an allowed network. Regular users can continue to sign in remotely. API-key integrations are unchanged.

proposal: Batasi login administrator ke jaringan tepercaya
source_en: Restrict Administrator Sign-In to Trusted Networks

proposal: Masukkan setidaknya satu jaringan administrator yang diizinkan.
source_en: Enter at least one allowed administrator network.

proposal: Wajibkan login Jellyfin Quick Connect
source_en: Require Jellyfin Quick Connect Sign-In

proposal: Izinkan login Jellyfin Quick Connect dan blokir login dengan kata sandi Jellyfin atau melalui plugin Jellyfin.
source_en: Allow Jellyfin Quick Connect sign-in and block Jellyfin password and plugin sign-in.
